body: Independent orchestrator review of PR #383 at the head the chain fetches after the update-branch onto the current main (the worker's head 7b776a30 on b167fe0a; task dotfiles-T128-seat-launch-args-a01, pair-confirmed at 148f5dde; branch feat/seat-launch-args-check): the diff touches the four files the task's allowed_files name and the evidence dir. scripts/orchestrator/seat-args.sh (new, item 1): the identity grammar kind-profile-suffix with an underscore allowed in the profile (the Bot's 4301264676), the expected pairs read from ~/.agents/model-profiles.env by an awk prefix match on the exact key, never sourced; /bin/ps and /usr/sbin/lsof (else /usr/bin/lsof) by absolute path with the SEAT_ARGS_PS and SEAT_ARGS_LSOF seams; a missing or failing probe, or an empty process list, is `args=unknown-probe` exit 4 with one stderr line naming the probe (4301301556); a claude seat is the lowest-pid claude process carrying `-n <any team>-<identity>`, a codex seat the lowest-pid codex (or node …/codex) process whose lsof cwd is the project path, a per-pid lsof failure saved as the first diagnostic and the scan continued, no match with a diagnostic being unknown-probe and unlaunched only when every candidate was inspected (4301342120); each managed flag's occurrences must all carry the expected value, else differs (4301378546); `found=` prints the managed flag names with ok, differs or missing markers and no argv value, and the diagnostics print no argv (4301378550). scripts/check-regime-boundary.sh (item 2): in the linked-worktree loop, when the script and the rendered env exist, the identities rows are grouped by name with their teams comma-joined, seat-args.sh runs once per name, exit 2 or 3 is a violation line `worker <name> at <worktree>: <line>`, exit 4 is skipped; the header comment names the check. Tests (items 3 and 4): tests/unit/test_seat_args.py (new) with the named test and 34 subcases (resumed, differing, matching, underscore profile, the codex decoy by cwd with the lower pid, the uninspectable decoy, every candidate uninspectable, the unsourced env value, the private positional prompt absent from all output, the missing probes), and tests/unit/test_check_regime_boundary.py with the named case (two teams, the violation line once, the skip without a probe, the existing lines kept). Caps 161 source / 322 test lines. No P0/P1 from this review.
